info.description: Job-search tracker: positions, people, events, resumes and goals. Every route except sign-up, login, session and health needs the session cookie set by login. Unsafe methods are rejected when the browser marks them cross-site or same-site; JSON bodies must be sent as application/json.
info.title: AppTracker API

post.description: Starts a new session (a fresh session ID) and sets the session cookie.
Email is lowercased and must be unused. Password is 12–128 characters. Sets the session cookie.
post.summary: Create an account and sign in

put.description: Full replace: fields not sent are cleared.

get.description: A zip holding data.json (every row you own) and resumes/<id>-<name>.pdf for each stored file. Streamed, so there is no size cap.
Returns defaults (5 applications a week, everything else null) until goals are saved.

put.description: Full replace (upsert). weeklyApplications must be at least 1.
Full replace: fields not sent are cleared.

delete.description: Events that mention this person keep their other details; their person link is cleared.

post.description: appliedAt is stamped with today's date (UTC) when the status is applied or beyond and none is sent.

put.description: Full replace: fields not sent are cleared, except appliedAt, which keeps its stored value when omitted. It is stamped with today's date (UTC) the first time the status reaches applied or beyond.

post.description: PDF only (checked by content type or extension, and by the %PDF- signature), 15 MB max, 25 per user.

parameters.description: Label; defaults to the file name without .pdf
parameters.name: name

delete.description: Removes the file first; if that fails the row is kept and the response is 500. Positions using the resume are unlinked.

get.description: Always an attachment named resume.pdf with nosniff, so a PDF's embedded script never runs in the app's origin and the user's label never reaches a header.

appliedAt.description:
Stamped with today's date (UTC) the first time status reaches applied or
beyond. An existing value is kept when this is omitted.
